prose: Laurel Airica returns to the show for another round of word magic fun! As a professional performance poet and etymological explorer, Laurel reveals the unknown significance of everyday verbiage, and makes phonetics fun again.
topics: How language creates the holo-grammatical dream of our reality
Entering the vortex, flow state, or god zone
AI and the computer code colonization of the world
music: Outro, "Banner of Grief" remix by Drumspyder
